# Google Workspace

Google Workspace provides curated Gmail and Google Calendar tools for common
agent workflows: sending email, checking recent or matching email, creating
calendar events, and checking upcoming calendar events.

## Categories

communication, calendar, email, productivity

## Aliases

google, gmail, google calendar, workspace

## Provider Parameters

- `bearer_token`: OAuth 2.0 access token with the Gmail or Calendar scopes required by the selected tool.
- `gmail_base_url`: Optional Gmail API base URL. Defaults to https://gmail.googleapis.com.
- `calendar_base_url`: Optional Calendar API base URL. Defaults to https://www.googleapis.com.

## Tools

- [Check Calendar Events](./tools/check-calendar-events): List Google Calendar events in a time window.
- [Check Emails](./tools/check-emails): Search recent Gmail messages and return readable summaries.
- [Create Calendar Event](./tools/create-calendar-event): Create an event on a Google Calendar.
- [Send Email](./tools/send-email): Send a Gmail message to one or more recipients.
